# Forward-chaining check of the boardgame question.
# Assumption (closed world): any atom not stated in the game state is False.
# Rule preferences are applied only when two rules would conclude opposite values.

AFRICA = {"Nigeria", "Kenya", "Egypt", "South Africa"}  # Nigeria is in Africa

state = {
    "ant_deal_stork": True,
    "dalmatian_not_trade_stork": True,   # "does not trade one of its pieces with the stork"
    "stork_money": 98,
    "walrus_money": None,                # not stated -> comparison cannot hold
    "mouse_location": "Nigeria",
    "mouse_works_agriculture": False,    # not stated
    "mouse_hugs_dinosaur": False,        # not stated
    "llama_has_instrument": False,       # not stated
    "someone_acquires_fish_photo": True, # "the dragon acquires a photograph of the fish"
}

def b(x):
    return bool(x)

# Rule4: mouse in Africa -> mouse smiles at cobra
mouse_in_africa = state["mouse_location"] in AFRICA
r4 = mouse_in_africa
# Rule7: mouse works in agriculture -> not smiles at cobra (preferred over Rule4)
r7 = b(state["mouse_works_agriculture"])
mouse_smiles_cobra = False if r7 else r4

# Rule3: stork money > walrus money -> stork does NOT build plant (preferred over Rule1)
walrus = state["walrus_money"]
r3 = walrus is not None and state["stork_money"] > walrus
# Rule1: ant deal with stork and dalmatian not trading -> stork builds plant
r1 = b(state["ant_deal_stork"]) and b(state["dalmatian_not_trade_stork"])
stork_builds_plant = False if r3 else r1

# Rule2: some animal builds a plant -> mouse does not shout at beetle
r2_not_shout = any([stork_builds_plant])

# Rule5: hugs dinosaur and smiles at cobra -> shouts at beetle (preferred over Rule2)
r5_shout = b(state["mouse_hugs_dinosaur"]) and mouse_smiles_cobra

# Resolve the Rule5 vs Rule2 conflict by preference
if r5_shout:
    mouse_shouts_beetle = True
elif r2_not_shout:
    mouse_shouts_beetle = False
else:
    mouse_shouts_beetle = None

print("mouse_in_africa =", mouse_in_africa)
print("mouse_smiles_cobra =", mouse_smiles_cobra)
print("walrus_money given =", walrus is not None)
print("rule3_fires =", r3)
print("stork_builds_plant =", stork_builds_plant)
print("rule5_fires =", r5_shout)
print("mouse_shouts_beetle =", mouse_shouts_beetle)

submitted = "proved"
if mouse_shouts_beetle is False:
    verdict = "disproved"
elif mouse_shouts_beetle is True:
    verdict = "proved"
else:
    verdict = "unknown"

print("derived verdict =", verdict)
print("submitted verdict =", submitted)
print("CHECK PASS" if verdict == submitted else "CHECK FAIL")
